name: Human Physiology
summary: How the organ systems of the human body work and are regulated to keep conditions stable (homeostasis).

topics.name: Nervous system physiology: neurons, reflexes and autonomic control
Muscle physiology: skeletal, cardiac and smooth muscle (overview)
Cardiovascular physiology: cardiac cycle, ECG, blood pressure and its regulation
Blood: composition, haemostasis and blood groups
Respiratory physiology: ventilation, gas exchange and O2/CO2 transport
Renal physiology: filtration, reabsorption, secretion and urine concentration
Gastrointestinal physiology: digestion, absorption and motility
Human nutrition: macronutrients, micronutrients and energy balance
Integrated responses: exercise, altitude and stress
